notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (School Nutrition is within governmental funds), no business-type funds, so business_type is null. Top-level receipts/disbursements come from the Total Governmental Funds column (statement spans trimmed pp4-5; amounts cited to p5). Pages 1 and 2 are duplicate copies of the Statement of Net Position. Transfers (352,671.93 in and out) are eliminated in the Reclassification column so total-column transfers are printed as zero; transfers_in/out left null. Local receipts split into property tax, carline, motor vehicle, fines, sale of property and QCPU interest using the fund schedules (pp7, 12, 13); Interest split into interest on taxes and other interest using pp7, 12. Federal/state programs disbursements put in instruction (function not printed). Detail: General Fund op-expense schedule (pp15-20) is more detailed than the p8 function budget schedule, so p8 is not recorded (no double counting); lines with a zero actual (dash) were omitted. Labelled transfers to the Depreciation Fund (640 textbooks 25,000, 650 25,000, 610 25,000, 733 25,000, 732 100,000) and to Lunch/Activities funds are recorded as other financing (negative); these are inside the printed schedule totals (includes other financing). Activities fund recorded account by account from p21 (p10 one-line budget schedule left out); p22 is the prior-year (2024) activities schedule and is not recorded. p6 fund summary budget comparison not recorded as detail (fund totals only). Balance sheet is the cash-basis Statement of Net Position (p1); no liabilities printed, total_liabilities left null; component unit column (all zero) ignored.  Maintenance of plant (p18) total 354,647.25 includes an unlabelled 50,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p3 shows 304,647.25; p9 receives 250,000 vs 200,000 labelled): printed lines kept (they sum to the printed total; 720 Building improvements 50,000, budget 0, is probably the transfer but is not labelled as one), contra -50,000 expenditure and -50,000 other financing line added. Read pages 1-22 of 22 Statement Capital outlay 474,130.98 (p5) split using the Special Building Fund schedule (p12): capital lease payment 284,795.35 to debt service principal and lease interest 21,694.41 to debt service interest, remainder 167,641.22 capital outlay.
